articles.title: Saudis must recognise Israel for nuclear deal, says Trump
articles.description: The US president says the landmark agreement to help Saudis develop nuclear energy is dependent on it joining the Abraham Accords.

articles.title: India activist ends hunger strike after 26 days
articles.description: Sonam Wangchuk, a supporter of youth-led protesters demanding education reforms, says he wants to avert "possible violence".

articles.title: Yemen's Houthis attack Saudi tanker as US launches more Iran strikes
articles.description: The Iran-backed group, which previously announced a "maritime embargo" against Saudi Arabia, also claims to have hit another vessel.

articles.title: Nicaragua's legislature debates barring opposition from elections
articles.description: The move comes days after President Daniel Ortega demanded 'a wall, a blockade' against opposition parties.

articles.title: Russia's businesses under strain from Ukraine's attacks on Wildberries
articles.description: Ukrainian drones have hit several retail warehouses belonging to Russia's biggest online retailer Wildberries in a matter of days.

articles.title: Ghanaians' ICC petition over migrant attacks 'opportunistic', says South Africa
articles.description: The petition argues the violence against migrants in South Africa could amount to crimes against humanity.
